purpose: Optional implementation guidance, not a statement that preview controls or services implement these states
recommendations: Preserve source visible controls; do not invent extra product UI.
A marketing demonstration can use deterministic local fixtures; label simulation and avoid suggesting a real model executed it.
Keep animation state seek-safe; show readable static content under reduced motion.
Supply real destinations and configured form handling only when provided and authorized.
Do not present demo metrics, testimonials, certification badges, model logos or deployment claims as verified business facts.
